source_text.ISS-1038: Q-1039 / GH #2367: tests asserting on globally captured logs flake under concurrent tests

task.description: Diagnosis by ORCH from GH #2367: class = ExUnit capture_log is a global Logger capture; flakes: AuthzDenyLogTest lost line (run 37571670867), NotifierNoLeakTest untrusted_implicit saw another test's 'alert delivery exhausted' error (run 37668219153). Root cause test-side, not a product bug.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnosis names the failure class and the fix design

result.summary: Design: opt-in attributed synchronous :logger handler in test/support/logger_collector.ex (self/$callers/$ancestors/also_from); survey of the tree for absence/exact-count capture_log users by Explore agent (4 HIGH, ~14 MEDIUM).
